flow_rules.rule: if SECOND_SERVER_OPENING_ENABLED unset, MUST be routed to s1 only
if SECOND_SERVER_OPENING_ENABLED set, routes to newest open server with new_account_eligible=true
resumes stored active_server_id; falls back to s1 if missing
no automatic resource copy between servers
paid currency remains account-wide; not subject to server selection
free resources remain server-bound; do not appear across servers
server-aware route patch must be applied before non-default server selection can succeed

selection_decision_tree: IF SERVER_PROFILES_RUNTIME_ENABLED unset: return implicit s1 only for GET endpoints; reject POST with 423 server_profiles_runtime_disabled
ELSE IF target_server.status == merged: return 308 with merged_into_server_id
ELSE IF target_server.status == closed_to_new AND requesting_account is new: return 403
ELSE IF target_server_id != s1 AND SECOND_SERVER_OPENING_ENABLED unset: return 423 second_server_locked
ELSE IF SLC-F route_patch_applied=false AND target_server_id != s1: return 423 route_patch_not_applied
ELSE: persist active_server_id and return 200 active_server_resolution
